notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by is a model, reviewed_by is null); no human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached, and no hardware, Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab or GPU run is claimed.

SERVED: one task of gh.deeproboticslab/rl_training, Amp-Flat-Deeprobotics-DR02-v0, registered at source/rl_training/rl_training/tasks/manager_based/locomotion/amp/config/humanoid/dr02/__init__.py:8-15 with entry point rl_training.envs:AmpLocomotionEnv. The card's entry symbol rl_training.envs.amp_locomotion_env:AmpLocomotionEnv was confirmed at source/rl_training/rl_training/envs/amp_locomotion_env.py:63; the card's other symbols are DR02AmpFlatEnvCfg (the env config this task uses) and DeeproboticsLite3RoughEnvCfg (a different robot/task, not served). The bridge serves cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 through the environment's step/reset interface.

WHY A FAKE: the card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but this repository needs Isaac Sim 5.1.0, Isaac Lab 2.3.2, Python 3.11 and Linux (README.md:33), and the clone is installed as an Isaac Lab extension; none of that is available where the gate runs, and package code never imports the clone. Only the package fake backend is declared. The registered task expects Isaac Lab env-config resolution, so the bare upstream gym.make path was not run and is not offered as a sim backend. The fake is an F0 kinematic stand-in, not a recording, and was not compared with an Isaac Lab run.

ACTION AND LIMITS: the DR02 AMP action is a joint-position target in DR02_DOF_ORDER (flat_env_cfg.py:66-67; assets/deeprobotics.py:287-295) with an internal per-joint clip (-10.0, 10.0) (amp_env_cfg.py:140). The Gymnasium action_space itself is built by Isaac Lab's action manager outside the clone, so no line of the clone defines it; the fake therefore uses an unbounded 21-element Box and the bridge publishes no finite action Limit (no action_space_ref is set, because the cited env code defines the internal clip, not the Gym Box). The fake applies the cited clip internally, so large in-range JSON values are accepted and clipped. There are no operator_required limits and no site-limits.example.json; the only other bounds are the catalogue/bridge bounds on ticks and seed.

OBSERVATION: the configured groups are policy 73, critic 121, amp_obs_history 305, obs_future 69 and vel 3 (amp_env_cfg.py:149-156). The fake returns all five groups with those sizes as a Gymnasium Dict; every value is placeholder state. The policy composition [ang_vel(3), proj_grav(3), cmd(3), cmd_flag(1), dof_pos(21), dof_vel(21), actions(21)] is cited (amp_env_cfg.py:150-151) and tested.

FIDELITY: F0 (kinematic/analytic), engine isaaclab:AmpLocomotionEnv (F0 fake stand-in), determinism seeded with seed_control parameter (the fake seeds Python random.Random; upstream seed/physics determinism was not established), timestep_ms 20.0 (decimation 4 x sim.dt 0.005 s, amp_env_cfg.py:675-680), realtime_factor 0, clock lockstep, reset full, snapshot_restore false. Gaps: no Isaac Sim/PhysX dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors, noise or rendering; no upstream reward or termination terms; the fake truncates at 1000 control ticks from the 20 s episode and never terminates; the upstream environment is vectorized over 4096 envs while the fake drives one; the unbounded fake action Box accepts values upstream would clip; no snapshot/restore; no wall-clock pacing.

SAFETY: simulated R0. There is no hardware backend and no native stop; the e-stop is the runtime's software latch (no step or reset after it, state stays readable). No physical stop or hardware protection is claimed.

WARNINGS (expected, none failing): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it records the seed for the next reset and makes no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x3 for action_space, observation_space and close (provided by the Isaac Lab/Gymnasium base outside the clone); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because no finite action Limit is declared (the suite awards CL2 and every other CL3 test passed); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived ticks, reset seed, seed input and action.values. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

NOT COVERED: the upstream Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab environment, its physics, reward, termination and observation computation; the registered env_cfg resolution and gym.make path; the 4096-env vectorization; rendering; snapshot/restore; any comparison of fake values or trajectories with an Isaac Lab run; any Deep Robotics hardware. No catalogue_requests: only the existing cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 classes are used. gate.digest is the digest line of the last CLI gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review checked the DR02 AMP registration/configuration, sibling Lite3 entry, action/observation declarations, sources, licences, fake and latch. Added adapter.py and site-limits.example.json and updated driver.py, fake.py, facts.md and test_driver.py to require an operator action envelope, retain the required-action schema, identify the engine as analytic F0 and label raw-input clipping/scaling gaps honestly. Updated driver.lock.json only in install metadata to use the source/rl_training extension path and Linux, preserving authorship, review signature and source pin; regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The fake gate G1-G9 and package regressions pass, including unset/violated envelopes; strict collection reports only RESULT_DIGEST_STALE pending orchestrator application. For the human reviewer: Accepted only as a fake-only DR02 AMP contract; no Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, GPU or hardware run. The example -100..100 input envelope is test data without physical units or upstream Box provenance. The fake clips raw inputs but does not reproduce external action-manager scales/default offsets/processing order, dynamics, reward, termination or 4096-env vectorization. A live path needs Isaac application lifecycle/config resolution and the BSD-3-Clause asset submodule; neither the Lite3 rough task nor separate robot-deployment repositories are served.
